note: The players who never got to join. Tenure split: ~two thirds of Swedish households own their home (villa or bostadsrätt), ~one third rent (SCB, boende i Sverige, 2024). Housing cost share of disposable income by tenure: rental 27 %, bostadsrätt 21 %, owned småhus 18 % (SCB hushållens boendeutgifter 2024). Stockholm queue: 894 592 registered at Bostadsförmedlingen 31 dec 2025; average wait 9.0 years for a regular rental, ~21 years for inner-city Stockholm. Young adults 20–27: 21 % (204 000 of 963 600) live with their parents, 9 of 10 involuntarily — the highest share ever measured (Hyresgästföreningen, Unga vuxnas boende 2025).
